newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha edges up on petrochemical demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha edges up on petrochemical demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices were slightly higher on Monday, boosted by tight paraffinic supplies and strong petrochemical demand, traders said.

Cargoes were priced at $229/$231 cif ARA while Nov swaps moved up about $3.50 from Friday to $231 and Dec swaps rose about $2 to $212, they said. "The physical is still tight," said one trader. "The petchem industry is driving it." One trader said he believed there were still three Russian cargoes on offer for NWE, but Russian exports were less than in September, which should support prices. -- John Hanley, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185
